ReadToEnd: Please read to the end before continuing.
Accept: I have reviewed and agree to the license terms
ChooseNetwork: Select the network to use with Clutch-CS.
ClusterNetworkHelp: All PCs in a group (cluster) must be on the same network.
Searching: Looking for clusters on the selected network…
PriorityHelp: Computers with higher values are preferred to manage the group.
PrivilegeHelp:
Current user: starts at sign-in. All users: starts with the computer (requires administrator permission).
Allowing network access in Windows requires administrator approval for either option.
AppearanceHelp: Leave empty to keep the default. Images: PNG or ICO.
Title: Title
SubTitle: Subtitle
UpdateFleet: Update one at a time (Fleet Update)
UpdateFleetHelp: Stop processing on each target, update it, and confirm it is Ready before moving on. Further updates wait if remaining PCs or an update outcome cannot be confirmed.
RemoveHelp: Your workspace files and logs will remain.
Warning: The selected copies of Clutch-CS will no longer be available. Deleted data cannot be restored.
RestartConfirm: I have saved my work and want to restart this computer
WebClientUpdateHelp: Select the web clients to update. Remote clients are listed when associated with an observed CoreService. Select the CoreService too when upgrading an older Core. To update only web clients, choose individual peers for the CoreService scope and clear their checkboxes.
ConfirmError: Please confirm the targets and their impact.
BusyClose: An operation is running. Wait for its result before closing.
RepairDescription: Fix problems with an existing installation.
WebClientInstalled: The installed web client will be used.
WebClientPortError: Enter a web client port between 1 and 65535.
WebClientPortInUse: This port is already in use. Choose a different port.
Progress.register: Configuring automatic startup and network access…
Progress.unregister: Removing startup and network access registrations…
Progress.update-check: Checking the target and update files…
Progress.update-hold: Pausing work on the selected installations…
Progress.update-exclude: Isolating an installation that could not be verified…
Progress.update-BackedUp: Previous files have been backed up
Progress.update-Installed: Updated program files have been installed
Progress.update-Starting: Waiting for startup and checking the update…
Progress.update-Completed: Startup of the updated version has been confirmed
Progress.update-RolledBack: The previous version is running again
Progress.update-Interrupted: The update result could not be confirmed
Progress.outcome-Failed: Could not complete. Check the details.
Progress.outcome-Unknown: The result could not be confirmed. Check the target before trying again.
WebClientServiceStartup: Run as a service (shared by all users)
WebClientStartupHelp: If unchecked, the web client starts at sign-in with standard user privileges.
